tamil nadu.registration_deadline: Voter registration is continuous but usually closes a few weeks before the polling date. Apply online via the Voters' Services Portal (voters.eci.gov.in) using Form 6.
tamil nadu.id_requirements: EPIC (Voter ID card) is standard. Alternatively, Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, MNREGA Job Card, or a valid Passport can be used to prove identity at the polling booth.

west bengal.registration_deadline: Apply online via the Voters' Services Portal (voters.eci.gov.in) or the Voter Helpline App using Form 6.
west bengal.id_requirements: EPIC (Voter ID card) is the primary document. Aadhaar, PAN Card, Driving License, or Indian Passport are also accepted.

uttar pradesh.registration_deadline: Voter registration is open. Apply online via the Voters' Services Portal (voters.eci.gov.in) using Form 6.
uttar pradesh.id_requirements: EPIC (Voter ID card), Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Driving License, or Bank/Post Office Passbook with photo.

maharashtra.next_election: The State Legislative Assembly Election recently concluded in November 2024. Next assembly election will be in 2029.
maharashtra.registration_deadline: Registration is open year-round for future elections. Use Form 6 on the Voter Helpline App or voters.eci.gov.in.
maharashtra.id_requirements: EPIC (Voter ID card) or any of the 11 alternative photo identity documents approved by the ECI, such as Aadhaar or PAN.
